description: Output schema for npm supply chain security audit report

integrity_match.description: Whether tarball SHA-512 SRI hash matches the expected integrity value from registry metadata

compromised.description: Whether the package contains embedded malicious code

attack_type.description: How the malicious code is triggered (e.g. postinstall, runtime)

malicious_file.description: Relative path to file containing malicious code

evidence.description: Evidence entries. Compromised packages must include at least one semgrep:-prefixed entry.

related_advisories.description: Advisory IDs from the NDJSON feed whose indicators are confirmed present in source code.

behavior_summary.description: Description of the malicious behavior if compromised.
